visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt under a striped cropped vest and blue jeans, walks along a tree-lined sidewalk under bright natural daylight. The background features green trees and a modern glass office building. A large white text overlay centered on the screen reads 'POV：在路上遇到前任'. (2) The scene cuts as the woman stops and reacts with exaggerated surprise, holding her hand to her mouth. A white title '分手還是朋友型' appears. She leans toward the camera, smiling and waving warmly, acting as if she is greeting an old friend. The camera follows her movements with a slight handheld shake. (3) The woman shifts to a cold, indifferent expression, crossing her arms and looking away from the camera. The text '分手不是朋友型' is displayed. She adjusts her hair and walks past the lens without acknowledging the viewer. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout this phase. (4) The video transitions to a black-and-white filter as she acts out the '不想分手型.' She looks distressed, reaching out toward the camera with a pleading expression and watery eyes. Detailed subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen describing her feelings of loneliness. (5) Color returns as she points aggressively at the camera, looking angry and shouting. The title '冤家路窄型' appears. She appears to be demanding money back for various expenses, gesturing emphatically with her finger. (6) She walks confidently with a black bag over her shoulder, looking back at the camera with a superior smirk for the '優越型' scenario. The camera pans to follow her as she walks away. (7) The setting transitions to a warm indoor living room. The woman is seated on a yellow sofa, holding and demonstrating two small glass bottles of DR.WU serum. She applies the clear liquid to her face in close-up shots, highlighting her glowing skin. (8) A split-screen comparison appears labeled 'BEFORE' and 'AFTER', showing the improvement in her skin texture and radiance. The final shot is a high-quality product display of the two serum bottles on a wooden table with the brand logo prominently shown.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator performing various roleplay scenarios and product demonstrations.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long straight dark hair. She initially wears a white t-shirt under a black-and-white striped vest and light blue flared jeans. Later, she is seen in an indoor setting wearing a black apron over a white top.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The first half takes place on a city sidewalk with a row of green trees, a modern glass office building, and a road with passing cars. The second half is set in a cozy indoor living room with a yellow sofa, neutral-colored walls, and soft lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track. A female voice provides energetic narration with high arousal, introducing the 'ex-meeting' scenarios. The BGM features a steady synth pulse and sharp electronic drum hits. (2) A sharp 'click' sound effect, similar to a camera shutter, triggers a new phase as she roleplays the first scenario. Her voice is high-pitched and enthusiastic. (3) A 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the jump between scenarios. Her tone shifts dramatically to cold and flat, then to a distressed, high-arousal crying sound during the monochrome visual segment. (4) The music continues but the narrative tone becomes calmer and more professional as she transitions into promoting the skincare brand. A melodic 'ding' sound effect highlights the key ingredients as they are mentioned. (5) The final phase features a steady, uplifting musical accompaniment as she explains the skin benefits. The vocal delivery is clearly enunciated and persuasive, ending with a branded stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> List-based Scenarios -> Product Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote DR.WU Mandelic Acid skincare products by utilizing a humorous and relatable 'meeting an ex' scenario to emphasize the importance of having glowing, healthy skin in any situation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product, close-ups of packaging, brand logo overlays, and detailed explanation of product benefits and ingredients.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively blends social media meme culture with a commercial advertisement, using high-energy editing and relatable roleplay to engage the audience before moving into a traditional product review/showcase.
